{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: mount the nuphus-mcp desktop automation MCP server as native tools (mcp__nuphus-mcp__*).","id":"gh:1338181003","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-nuphus-mcp","slug":"mrpulor-gh/dsh-nuphus-mcp","topics":["browser","computer-use","cordis","deepseek-harness","desktop-automation","dsh-plugin","mcp","model-context-protocol","stdio"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: mount the nuphus-mcp desktop automation MCP server as native tools (m"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"SH) plugin: mount the nuphus-mcp desktop automation MCP server as native tools (mcp__nuphus-mcp__*)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-nuphus-mcp"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DSH plugin that mounts nuphus-mcp

a thin Cordis wrapper that spawns the `nuphus-mcp` binary over stdio via
`@deepseek-ai/"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"hin Cordis wrapper that spawns the `nuphus-mcp` binary over stdio via
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Restart `dsh --profile web` — activation is automatic (`dsh.bundle.patch`)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Discovers the connected server's tools as `mcp__nuphus-mcp__*`; the count and schemas depend on th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"at server build
- Auto-installs `nuphus-mcp` on first boot if missing on `PATH`
- `--confirm-write` "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"on by default (write tools need `"confirm": true`)
- Same `NUPHUS_MCP_*` env vars as every other cli"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ent
- Keeps one MCP client for the plugin lifetime; tool calls preserve the server's descriptions, a"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"rguments and results"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- DSH `web` profile, Node.js `^22.19` / `>=24`
- DSH must run in the desktop session of the controll"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"` profile, Node.js `^22.19` / `>=24`
- DSH must run in the desktop session of the controlled machine"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Overridable in `cordis.yml` / patch:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `serverName` | `nuphus-mcp` | Tool namespace |
| `command` | `nuphus-mcp` | Executable to spawn |
"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"| `args` | `["--confirm-write"]` | CLI args |
| `autoInstall` | `true` | Install the default command"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" if missing on PATH; set `false` for managed installations |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"call timeout (screenshots/OCR exceed 60000) |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`autoInstall` must be a boolean. A custom `command` is always used as supplied,
including paths cont"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"aining spaces or non-ASCII characters, and never triggers
an automatic install. Windows PATH probes "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"and installer processes are hidden;
the MCP SDK also hides its stdio child process."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Reuse the task page"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Use a server build containing nuphus-mcp PR #12
and PR #13, such as
commit `0a689c1`.
The published "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"`v0.3.3` release predates those changes; a `0.3.3` version string
alone does not establish that the "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"fixes are included. Updating this adapter or
auto-installing an older npm build cannot add the brows"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"er behavior by itself."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"With that server build:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. Use `mcp__nuphus-mcp__browser_navigate` for ordinary navigation. It reuses the
selected task page"},{"id":"p19s2","text":", including the startup page, instead of opening another tab.
2. To use another existing tab or a si"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"te popup, list tabs and select its fresh
index with `browser_switch_tab`. `target_id` identifies the"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" tab; `selected`
marks the task target and does not mean foreground focus.
3. Use `browser_new_tab` "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"only when a separate tab is needed. New/switch calls
default to background operation; pass `activate"},{"id":"p19s6","text":": true` only for an interaction
that needs the foreground. The adapter forwards omitted, false and t"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"rue
values unchanged. Write calls still require `confirm: true` by default.
4. If the task tab close"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"d, navigation can create one background replacement
instead of taking over an unrelated tab. If a cr"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"eate request has an unknown
outcome, list/select the intended tab before creating another one."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The first browser launch, an explicit activation and website-created popups can
still show a window."},{"id":"p20s2","text":" This wrapper does not intercept browser windows."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Recovery boundaries"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Browser CDP recovery is handled inside nuphus-mcp: it can reattach to a live
browser and selected ta"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rget without reloading the document; cancellation keeps
the owned browser alive, and crash recovery "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"reuses the fresh startup page.
The adapter does not automatically replay failed or timed-out write c"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"s the fresh startup page.
The adapter does not automatically replay failed or timed-out write calls."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The current `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` does **not** automatically reconnect a
disconnected MCP se"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"rver process. Reload the plugin with HMR or restart DSH, then
list/select the intended task tab agai"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"n. The old `reconnect` option was not
implemented by that client; it is now ignored with a diagnosti"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"c rather than

the relevant client after replacing a binary so existing sess"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ions use the new build."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"External-browser selection (`NUPHUS_MCP_BROWSER_CDP_URL`, `NUPHUS_BROWSER_*`),
the explicit intranet"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" opt-in (`NUPHUS_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NAV`) and action-effect

`config.env` values take precedence; the adapter does not enabl"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"e private-network
navigation or disable effect checks by default."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Tool list, vision keys and external-browser CDP setup live in the
